brief.subject: 챕터 범퍼 — 02 뇌를 닮은 기계
brief.goal: s04 직전 4초 챕터 범퍼 (인트로 s00 모션 릴 스타일)

visualStyle.medium: 2D vector motion graphics (SVG): flat Swiss color fields, geometric shape motifs, motion blur on every fast move
visualStyle.lighting: Flat solid color field per bumper (reel-* tokens), no gradients or glows
visualStyle.typography: Archivo Black chapter number (400px), Pretendard 900 Korean title, Playfair Display Italic accent line, JetBrains Mono HUD in the four corners
visualStyle.density: One chapter card, big type, generous negative space
visualStyle.cameraFeeling: Locked frame; elements whip in and out with directional motion blur

beats.visual: black color field wipes in from the right; the chapter number slams in from the left with motion blur and lands on the downbeat

beats.copy: 뇌를 닮은 기계 / Built like a brain.
beats.visual: ball motif plays on the right; Korean title rises word by word, italic serif line reveals, its dot pops; rule draws and the footer types (next scene, chapter rail, course)
Card holds while the motif keeps moving; HUD timecode runs
Everything whips left with motion blur and the deck background wipes in from the right
beats.notes: Ends on canvas-deep so the next slide crossfades in cleanly.

audio.soundDesign: Whoosh on the wipe, impact on the number, clap/hat groove under the title, blip on the dot, riser and reverse whoosh on the exit
audio.music: Procedural Web Audio (code, no samples, no generative AI), 120 BPM, one chord per chapter; rendered offline from a fixed seed, synced to the scene clock
